glb.decodedTextureEstimate: Active unique image sources: sum(width * height * 4 * 4/3); theoretical RGBA8 full mip chain.
glb.decodedTextureObjectsEstimate: Active texture indices: sum(source.width * source.height * 4 * 4/3); shared images counted per texture object.

metadata.scope: Metadata declarations; independent source/v1 file hashes are checked separately.

coordinateContract.nodeTransformNote: Static nodes are identity. Apply the fan node translation once; do not reapply source scale.
coordinateContract.scope: Checks the declared coordinate formula; does not identify the stage surface from merged geometry.

duplicateCheck.scope: Compares quantized world-space triangles and substantial vertex overlap at rest; does not prove absence of remodelled duplicates.

motion.engineFormula: model(theta) = T(pivot) * Rz(theta) * T(-pivot) * restWorld; theta = angularSpeed * seconds
motion.localGeometryFormula: With restWorld=T(pivot), model(theta)=T(pivot)*Rz(theta). Apply exactly once to mesh-local vertices.

resourceBudget.estimate: sum(width*height*4*4/3); texture objects include repeated source images where GLB binds separate texture indices.

scope.note: This receipt verifies asset structure and CPU transforms; render/reimport and game integration are separate checks.
